title: Witness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
abstract: arXiv:2609.31784v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. translated_title: 见证重叠：开放权重模型家族中的方向性溯源
translated_abstract: 开放权重模型经常经历发布、微调、对齐、合并和再次发布的过程，这使得溯源审计不仅要判断各个检查点（checkpoint）是否相关，还要判断哪个检查点出现得更早。许多现有的模型溯源方法是为“基座已知”的审计场景设计的：给定一个受害模型或源模型，检测某个可疑模型是否与它相关。尽管这些审计被表述为从源到可疑模型的检验，但其底层证据往往是对称的，依赖于表示相似性、权重相似性、行为指纹或相关性统计。对称的成对比较能够检测出相关性，但仅凭其本身无法确定检查点 A 与 B 之间关系的先后方向。因此，我们引入了一种局部几何比较方法：不是直接比较两个检查点，而是引入第三个同家族检查点作为“见证者”（witness），并比较每个候选端点周围的几何结构。方向是通过……
tldr: 该论文提出“见证重叠”方法，通过引入第三个同家族检查点作为见证者并进行局部几何比较，突破传统对称性证据的局限，从而在开放权重模型家族的溯源审计中判断两个相关检查点谁先谁后的方向性关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Witness Overlap," which adds a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compares the local geometry around each candidate endpoint, overcoming the limits of symmetric evidence to determine directional provenance—i.e., which of two related checkpoints in an open-weight model family came first.
